key_notes: Key 1 (t=3.92s): Initial archival pose of snake; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=5.04s): Mid-sequence articulation of snake; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=6.28s): Peak dynamic extension of snake over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.52s): Follow-through and settle of snake with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of snake (3.92s..7.52s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
